desktop_source_commit: a7576ae; production desktop code unchanged since the metadata fix
host: macOS 14.7.2 arm64, native wgpu/Metal debug builds

normal_desktop.scope: Independent ordinary light/dark launches, isolated Classic/v11 config/recovery, no frame-count override and no forced screenshot request. Both report regular activation policy (0), active=true, application menu PaintCraft and window Untitled - PaintCraft. Both native window captures contain complete ribbon, tool panel, canvas and status UI. Native Quit succeeds and each process exits zero. Raw captures reviewed directly.

framebuffer_example.scope: Real App with native services/recovery in explicit example. Context screenshot request asks native renderer to paint even while occluded. PNGs encoded through existing image-based formats API; straight RGBA conversion retained. Three-second post-readback inspection interval then viewport close. This diagnostic binary has its own native application identity; production naming was verified separately.
framebuffer_example.failures: Missing output argument exits 1 before a window is created; missing output directory produces a write error and exits 1 after the diagnostic window closes. No artifact is falsely reported as successful.

finding: The current ordinary desktop path renders and presents in both themes. An activation-policy hypothesis was disproved by the live regular/active report, so no production startup or renderer change was made. eframe source explicitly skips painting non-visible/occluded viewports unless a screenshot/PaintWhileHidden action requests it. Earlier inactive blank captures remain historical evidence; their exact trigger is not proven, and a persistent rendering defect was not reproduced.
limits: Qualifies current native window presentation baseline, naming and Quit on this host plus explicit readback tooling. It does not complete Windows reference parity, all native menu interactions, real brush/text/pen/IME input, other platforms, signing/notarization or the full roadmap. Earlier 167 normal GUI tests remain separate prior evidence; they were not rerun for this example-only addition. Ordinary tests/startup do not invoke the example.
